payload.reason: The evidence describes the training method of the selected sharing layer in the context of a multi-task learning framework for stance and fake news detection.

claims.text: The selected sharing layer is trained using a sifted multi-task learning method that incorporates a gate mechanism and attention mechanism to filter shared features between tasks.
The sifted multi-task learning method aims to improve performance by selecting relevant shared features and discarding irrelevant ones, thus enhancing task-specific outputs.
